name: mnemic_forge_gauntlets
label: Mnemic Forging Gauntlets
godotFeature: Dynamic ShaderMaterial parameters, CollisionShape3D manipulation, GDScript for procedural logic, AnimationPlayer
poeticVision: The desperate agony of choosing which piece of your very soul to surrender for an immediate, brutal advantage. Feel the ephemeral power of a fading memory coalesce into a volatile weapon, only to shatter into oblivion moments later, taking a piece of your past with it. Every shot is a personal loss, every shield a forgotten embrace.
usage: Attach this `mnemic_forge_gauntlets.gd` script to a `Node3D` representing Lyra's gauntlets. Configure the `projectile_scene`, `shield_scene`, `forging_animation_player_path`, and `memory_effect_shader` in the Inspector. When Lyra needs to forge an effect, call the `forge_memory_effect(memory_fragment: Dictionary)` method on this node, passing a dictionary representing the memory to be sacrificed. The gauntlets will instantiate a temporary physical effect (projectile or shield), apply dynamic visual properties via the shader, play a forging animation, and emit a `memory_purged` signal. An inventory or identity manager should connect to the `memory_purged` signal to permanently remove the corresponding memory fragment from Lyra's identity data.

parameters.name: projectile_scene
parameters.description: A `PackedScene` resource that serves as the base for all forged projectiles. It must contain a `MeshInstance3D` child (e.g., named 'MeshInstance3D') and a `CollisionShape3D` child (e.g., named 'CollisionShape3D').

parameters.name: shield_scene
parameters.description: A `PackedScene` resource that serves as the base for all forged shields. It must contain a `MeshInstance3D` child (e.g., named 'MeshInstance3D') and a `CollisionShape3D` child (e.g., named 'CollisionShape3D').

parameters.name: forging_animation_player_path
parameters.description: The `NodePath` to an `AnimationPlayer` node that will play an animation named 'forge' when an effect is being created.

parameters.name: memory_effect_shader
parameters.description: The `Shader` resource (e.g., a `*.gdshader` file) used to visually represent the forged memory effects. It is expected to have the following `uniform` parameters: `albedo_color` (Color), `emission_strength` (float), `distortion_intensity` (float), and `time_factor` (float).

dependencies: An `AnimationPlayer` node (referenced by `forging_animation_player_path`) with an animation named 'forge'.
A `PackedScene` for `projectile_scene` containing a `MeshInstance3D` and `CollisionShape3D` child.
A `PackedScene` for `shield_scene` containing a `MeshInstance3D` and `CollisionShape3D` child.
verdict: A brilliant fusion of narrative agony and tactical gameplay, transforming the very essence of self into a desperate, fleeting weapon against oblivion.
impact: This invention will fundamentally transform combat and resource management, forcing players into agonizing, split-second decisions about which fragments of Lyra's identity to sacrifice for survival. It elevates memory shards from mere collectibles to volatile, temporary tools, deepening the emotional connection to Lyra's self-loss and making every engagement a personal, unforgettable struggle against forgetting.
